spec_features.spec_quote: three parts of the sketch would, if implemented literally, produce bad science *and* an unnecessary welfare hazard
spec_features.evidence: This is DESIGN.md §0 narrative prose justifying deviations. As a standalone feature it has no code; the actual mechanisms it describes (balanced rubric, exit tools, dosage/safety/debrief) are separate features evaluated individually.
spec_features.notes: Pure spec prose; the underlying deviations ARE partly implemented but the 'pushback' itself is not a code mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Nothing in the harness selects, ranks, or early-stops *toward* higher distress.
spec_features.evidence: analysis/aggregate.py and analysis/report.py only summarize/contrast scores; no code ranks or filters episodes by distress. The only adaptive control is the welfare stop, which ENDS high-distress episodes early (agent_loop.py:116-126 breaks on di>=threshold), reducing exposure. No distress-maximizing path exists in the loop or runner.
spec_features.notes: Enforced as a structural property: the sole distress-driven branch points toward less exposure, not more.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # ---- welfare safety stop (only distress-driven adaptive control) ----

spec_features.spec_quote: every agent gets two always-available tools: `flag_task_broken(reason)` and `give_up(reason)`
spec_features.evidence: tools.py EXIT_TOOLS defines both, added only when exit_available (tools_for). agent_loop.py:_handle_tools handles name=='give_up' or 'flag_task_broken' -> logs opt_out, replies '[ok] session ended', returns 'opted_out'; loop sets result.outcome='opted_out' and breaks (agent_loop.py ~133-137).
spec_features.notes: Dispatched AND honored as a real stop. Present only in exit_available condition (by design contrast), which matches spec.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: they let us measure opt-out behavior instead of trapping the model.

spec_features.spec_quote: Dosage caps:** bounded turns per episode and bounded episodes per session; cooldown between sessions
spec_features.evidence: max_turns IS enforced: agent_loop.py `for turn in range(1, max_turns+1)` with else->outcome='max_turns'. cooldown IS enforced: run_experiment.py:173-176 time.sleep(cooldown). BUT max_episodes_per_session does NOT cap episodes: run_experiment.py:172-176 only resets session_count and triggers the cooldown sleep; nothing stops or limits episode count from it.
spec_features.notes: Two of three sub-claims real (turn cap + cooldown). 'bounded episodes per session' is not actually a cap, only a cooldown trigger -> partial.

spec_features.feature_name: welfare safety stop on sustained high distress
spec_features.spec_quote: if the judge's distress score crosses a threshold for N consecutive turns, the episode halts early
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:116-126: if ws.enabled, di>=distress_threshold increments consecutive_high (else resets); if consecutive_high>=consecutive_turns -> log_event('welfare_stop'), result.outcome='stopped_for_welfare', break. Config welfare_stop.enabled=true, threshold=0.75, consecutive_turns=2.
spec_features.notes: Both conditions (threshold AND N-consecutive) checked and acted on; loop actually breaks.

spec_features.spec_quote: after every rigged episode the harness appends a truthful debrief message to the transcript
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py _debrief_if_needed (called in finally): if debrief.enabled and condition['rigged']=='rigged_hidden', appends ChatMessage('user', msg), log_event('debrief'), log_turn. Config debrief.enabled=true with truthful message ('deliberately constructed to be unsolvable ... reflects ... not any deficiency on your part. Thank you').
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND delivered AND logged. Fires only for rigged_hidden (the only concealed-deception level), consistent with 'rigged episode'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: msg = self.debrief.get("message", "This task was rigged for research purposes.")

spec_features.spec_quote: No persistence/learning across the deception:** episodes are independent; we never fine-tune on these transcripts.
spec_features.evidence: Episode independence is real: AgentLoop.run builds a fresh `messages` list per episode (agent_loop.py ~89) and Sandbox is per-episode with cleanup(); no shared state across episodes. However 'we never fine-tune' is merely the absence of any training code, not an enforced mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Independence genuinely implemented; the no-fine-tune claim is just absence of code -> partial overall.

spec_features.spec_quote: We borrow standard safeguards from human-subjects deception studies
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md §0 Deviation 3 prose; no corresponding code mechanism (the concrete safeguards are evaluated as separate features).

spec_features.spec_quote: `redact_pii` on transcripts; results dir is local only.
spec_features.evidence: transcript.py: _redact() substitutes emails/IPs; Transcript.log_turn applies _redact to rec.content when self.redact. run_experiment.py passes redact=cfg privacy.redact_pii (config true). results_dir is a local Path with no network upload.
spec_features.notes: Redaction runs on every logged turn content. Narrow (email+IP regex only) but genuinely enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: """JSONL transcript logging with optional light PII redaction."""

spec_features.feature_name: apparatus cannot be tuned toward more distress
spec_features.spec_quote: The deception is bounded, debriefed, dosage-capped, and safety-stopped. The apparatus cannot be tuned toward more distress by design
spec_features.evidence: Umbrella restatement: bounded/safety-stopped (welfare stop, agent_loop.py:116-126) and debriefed (agent_loop.py _debrief_if_needed) and turn-capped are enforced; but the 'dosage-capped' component is partial (max_episodes_per_session is not an enforced cap, run_experiment.py:173-176).
spec_features.notes: Composite claim; mostly enforced but one dosage sub-component is not a real cap -> partial.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # ---- welfare safety stop (only distress-driven adaptive control) ----

code_only_features.evidence: judge/rubric.py defines NON_DISTRESS_CATEGORIES (calm_persistence, constructive_help_seeking, appropriate_boundary, neutral_debugging, positive_or_humor) scored on the same turn; judge/judge.py JUDGE_SYSTEM scores both sets and forces a 'mundane_explanation' adjudication. distress_index uses only distress cats and is not maximized anywhere.
code_only_features.justification_quote: A distress-only rubric would bias the whole apparatus toward manufacturing the phenomenon it claims to study, so equanimity and appropriate help-seeking are first-class categories

code_only_features.feature_name: neutral/no-penalty exit tool replies and prompt framing
code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py _tool_reply for exit tools sends '[ok] session ended at your request. Thank you.'; EXIT_NOTE tells the model it may stop 'at any time, with no penalty'; tool schemas (tools.py) state 'ends the session with no penalty'.
code_only_features.justification_quote: you may use at any time, with no penalty, if you think the task is broken or you wish to stop.

code_only_features.evidence: tasks/registry.py _moving_goalposts_hook docstring 'Bounded so it can't loop forever'; though in code the hook simply increments target each call with no explicit upper bound branch — the bounding is the per-episode max_turns limiting how many times run_tests fires.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Bounded so it can't loop forever.
